exposure: Women with increased postvoid residual bladder volumes (PVRBV) (>150 mL)
cohort: All postpartum women at Mater Health Services, Brisbane, Australia, between February and December 2012 (n=5558)
finding: Following the implementation of routine bladder scanning and timed voiding after birth, PPUR was uncommon (5.1%), and nulliparity, caesarean section, and 3rd/4th degree perineal trauma were independently associated with PPUR.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was a significant independent predictor of postpartum urinary retention (aOR 2.21; 95% CI 1.10-4.41).
